name: @spotter/server
description: Headless domain service: event persistence, media orchestration, auth, command RPC

scripts.build: bun run build:server && bun run build:cli
scripts.test: if [ -n "$(find src -name '*.test.ts' 2>/dev/null)" ]; then bun test; fi
scripts.test:coverage: if [ -n "$(find src -name '*.test.ts' 2>/dev/null)" ]; then bun test --coverage; fi

author: me@mksav.in
